Building an institutional-grade High-Frequency Trading system is typically a multi-year effort requiring a specialized team of engineers, quants, and infrastructure experts.

I just built one entirely by myself.

Over the last few weeks, I’ve been leveraging Cursor and bleeding-edge AI models to single-handedly architect, document, and execute BTNET — a quant-first, production-engineered, low-latency basis, stat-arb & momentum trading platform built for crypto, sports betting and prediction markets.
To give you an idea of the scale, this isn't a simple API wrapper. It’s a comprehensive, multi-repo platform that bridges ultra-low-latency execution with state-of-the-art code practices and 99.9% uptime capability.

We just finalized a massive 50-item "one-pass" implementation plan to take our Hyperliquid spot-perp basis execution fully live. Obviously, a single pass like that will require days of testing, improvement and validation with the Simex I built, but the path to testing reduces drastically.

Here is a glimpse under the hood of what the AI and I have built:
⚡ AERON IPC HOT PATHS: A shared Rust backbone utilizing Aeron for microsecond-latency market data and order entry streams, complete with custom backoff idle strategies and lock-free crossbeam queues.
📊 THREE-TIER MARKET DATA GATEWAYS (MDG): Highly optimized ingestion isolating L1 (BBO), L2 (depth), and FOG (funding/mark) data to ensure high-priority signals are never head-of-line blocked. Designed from the ground up for feed arbitration and signal-calibration.
🛠️ PRODUCTION-GRADE LOGICAL OMS: An in-memory authoritative Order Management System with hard Sub-Account isolation, venue fuses, and asynchronous Redis pub/sub fanout for durability with lower latency penalties.
🧠 DETERMINISTIC SIMEX: A fully deterministic simulated exchange for perfect strategy replay and acceptance testing, modeling exact execution modes.

As a quant trader and software engineer, the capability to compress the timeline from whiteboarding an architecture of this magnitude to having a fully functional, containerized, GitOps-driven deployment is mind-blowing.
The AI acts as a sounding board, a boilerplate generator, and a relentless pair programmer. The 50-item live-mode roadmap we just mapped out—covering everything from websocket fill fallbacks to risk hierarchy shard routing—is already well underway.

The barrier to entry for building complex, institutional financial infrastructure has been shattered - it is lower than ever, and Quants can own more, maybe all, of the infrastructure.
If you’re building in the HFT or DeFi space, I’d love to connect and hear how you are utilizing these new models to scale your output.
